description: Source code for the lexical analyzer component of the Lua interpreter, implementing tokenization and string parsing.

methods.name: luaX_init
methods.description: Initializes reserved words and environment name in the Lua lexical analyzer.

methods.name: luaX_token2str
methods.description: Converts a token to its string representation.

methods.name: txtToken
methods.description: Returns a string description of a token, saving it in the buffer.

methods.name: lexerror
methods.description: Handles lexical errors by throwing syntax errors with context info.

methods.name: luaX_syntaxerror
methods.description: Reports a syntax error with a custom message.

methods.name: luaX_newstring
methods.description: Creates and interns a new string in the scanner's table, ensuring uniqueness.

methods.name: inclinenumber
methods.description: Increments line number and skips newline sequences.

methods.name: luaX_setinput
methods.description: Initializes the lexer with input source, buffer, and state.

methods.name: llex
methods.description: Main lexical analyzer function that returns the next token.

methods.name: luaX_lookahead
methods.description: Peeks at the next token without consuming it.
